text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...I knew it, it's increased a little.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I have to restrict my diet. Without 
losing muscle mass as much as possible—)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, I wondered who it was, 
and here it turns out to be Ayabe-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what a coincidence running into 
you in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-kun, you seem to be struggling with 
weight management.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Bwahahaha! Seeing you so flustered means 
I must have hit the bullseye."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why, it was an entirely simple deduction. 
After seeing you step onto the scale with 
such a gloomy look, that is.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if that's true, it has nothing to 
do with you."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It has everything to do with it! First of 
all, you should thank me. After all, I 
came here to deliver once-in-a-lifetime 
good news to you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I assume you're looking for another 
test subject for some potion or other."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, quite an astute deduction, Ayabe-kun. 
Spot-on, in fact. I've succeeded in 
developing a new drug that can freely 
control weight.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about it? I gain research data, and 
you reap the fruit of your ideal weight. A 
win-win proposal, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have no need for that. Well then.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's a shame. But if you ever change 
your mind, feel free to let me know 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I need to properly manage my weight so I 
don't get dragged into weird 
experiments...)

Using this as a turning point, Admire Vega 
committed herself to a serious diet and 
succeeded in losing weight.
